plot_type: Deterministic audited-update response across two theory parameters

presentation_logic.claim: Increasing targeted auditing moves the specified S construction from an initially harmful update to an improving update; fixed-L transition and uniform guarantee are different thresholds.
presentation_logic.primary_comparison: Initial one-step accuracy change across L and q at fixed a,b,theta0,eta
presentation_logic.chart_rationale: A color field displays the two-parameter region; slices expose exact changes and the transition at selected L values.
presentation_logic.expected_takeaway: The benefit of auditing depends on both its probability and the input-magnitude contrast.
presentation_logic.failure_mode: If threshold labels or signs become unreadable, simplify annotations or enlarge the map without changing the data.

provenance.notes: Closed-form scan independently checked at every generated point; q display is multiplied by 100 and delta_P by 100.

reproducible.source: scan_parameters.json + generate_audit_scan.py + CSV grids + palette + figure briefs

reference_case.target_use: RSI audit parameter map and a separate explanatory surface
reference_case.reference_goal: Use ordered scientific panels, readable threshold annotations and local detail without copying the reference metric.
reference_case.local_translation: Project-owned L/q grids encode the deterministic initial accuracy change under the manuscript audit policy.
borrow: A focused view near the transition
adapt: Replace the reference interval length with project-owned delta accuracy; replace positive-only colors with a zero-centered diverging scale.
reject: Reference Monte Carlo values, interval-length definition, beta/nu symbols, scientific claims and sequential color semantics.

translation_map.verification: The detail has declared ranges and computed data rather than a stretched image.

translation_map.local_translation: Brown/white/teal encode harm/zero/improvement; color zero is exactly zero percentage points.
